Name: The Price of Timber Outfits Compatibility
Author: WSAEZ
Description:
[size=4][b]Demetrius wears the outfits of Seasonal Cute Characters in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41465]The Price of Timber[/url], and his sleep animation keeps working.[/b][/size]

The Price of Timber gives Demetrius a sleeping bag animation that uses an extra row in his sprite sheet. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] swaps his sheet for seasonal ones that do not have that row, so when he goes to sleep the game draws from outside the image. This mod adds the missing row to those sheets while the game runs. It contains [b]no art[/b]: the row is taken from the sheet The Price of Timber already loads.

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41465]The Price of Timber[/url] (required), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] and, optionally, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional, for the in-game options).[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Option [font=Courier New]Outfit[/font] in Generic Mod Config Menu, or in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]:
[list]
[*][b]Auto[/b] (default): the first supported outfit mod you have installed (Seasonal Cute Characters), otherwise the outfit of The Price of Timber.[/*]
[*][b]Seasonal Cute Characters[/b]: the seasonal outfits of Seasonal Cute Characters, in every season, with The Price of Timber's sleep animation. The calendar sprite follows the season too.[/*]
[*][b]Price of Timber[/b]: the outfit of The Price of Timber. The outfits of Seasonal Cute Characters are removed from Demetrius (his portraits go back to the original ones too).[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Needs The Price of Timber ([font=Courier New]spphcmttron.ThePriceOfTimber[/font]). Seasonal Cute Characters ([font=Courier New]Poltergeister.SeasonalCuteCharacters[/font]) is optional.[/*]
[*]Seasonal Outfits by Tanpoponoko is not supported yet.[/*]
[*]If the selected outfit mod is not installed, The Price of Timber's outfit is used and a warning is logged.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The sleep row is read from The Price of Timber's winter sheet ([font=Courier New]Characters/Demetrius_Winter[/font]), whose sleep row is the same as the base sheet's in version 1.0.1.[/*]
[*]In winter the calendar sprite uses the indoor winter outfit.[/*]
[*]The [font=Courier New]Price of Timber[/font] value assumes The Price of Timber's edit of the base sheet is applied after Seasonal Cute Characters', which is the case with the default load order.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Credits and permissions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41465]The Price of Timber[/url] by spphcmttron. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] by Poltergeister and various artists.[/*]
[*]This mod includes no files or images from either of them, nor from the game. Nothing needs permission. At runtime it copies a few pixels already present in the game's memory; nothing is saved or redistributed.[/*]
[*]Parts of this mod's code and texts were created with AI assistance, reviewed by the author.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Changelog[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]1.0.0: first release.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b]Português (Brasil)[/b][/size]

[b]O Demetrius usa as roupas do Seasonal Cute Characters no The Price of Timber, e a animação de dormir continua funcionando.[/b]

O The Price of Timber usa uma linha extra na folha de sprites do Demetrius para a animação do saco de dormir. O Seasonal Cute Characters troca a folha por versões sazonais sem essa linha, então ao dormir o jogo desenha fora da imagem. Este mod acrescenta a linha que falta enquanto o jogo roda, sem trazer nenhuma arte: a linha vem da folha que o The Price of Timber já carrega.

Opção [font=Courier New]Outfit[/font]: [b]Auto[/b] (padrão; usa o Seasonal Cute Characters se instalado, senão a roupa do The Price of Timber), [b]Seasonal Cute Characters[/b] ou [b]Price of Timber[/b] (roupa própria do mod; as roupas do SCC saem do Demetrius, inclusive os retratos).

Requer SMAPI e The Price of Timber; Seasonal Cute Characters e Generic Mod Config Menu são opcionais. Créditos: spphcmttron (The Price of Timber) e Poltergeister (Seasonal Cute Characters). Nenhum arquivo deles ou do jogo é distribuído aqui.
